title: Woman Leaning on Stone Wall Near Bridge, 1950s B&W Snapshot
description: A black and white snapshot from the late 1950s depicting a young blonde woman leaning over a stone retaining wall. Behind her stands a large steel truss bridge structure against a clear sky. She is wearing quintessential mid-century casual attire, including a sleeveless white shirt, cuffed dark capri pants, and white slip-on flats. The photograph features decorative deckled edges.
